plan: To prioritize capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower volatility. Expect smaller swings, but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to small allocations, reducing overall leverage.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to lean into growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leverage and concentration, which amplifies both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of higher volatility and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs; strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield.
